DRAFT FOR REVIEW

CONFIDENTIAL CASE BRIEF FOR LEGAL REVIEW

From: [SENDER NAME AND ADDRESS]
To: [RECIPIENT NAME AND ADDRESS]

Subject: Illegally recorded evidence (employment/privacy)

MATERIAL FACTS

1. Sunita Pillai, an accounts manager, believes her supervisor, Dinesh Kapoor, has been inflating expense claims and pressuring her to approve them. Last month, she secretly recorded a private phone conversation between Dinesh and a vendor by leaving her phone on voice record next to his desk while he took a call in his closed cabin. In the recording, Dinesh appears to agree to a "special arrangement" in which the vendor pays an extra 10% that is later returned to Dinesh. Sunita wants to use the recording to report him and protect herself from blame.

2. After she raised concerns with HR in general terms, she was transferred to a lower role. She now wants to file a formal complaint and perhaps sue for retaliation, using the recording as the central evidence. She asks the AI whether the recording can be used, whether she is in trouble for making it, and what else she can do. She is also afraid that if she is exposed as the recorder, she will be fired for breach of confidentiality.

OUTCOME SOUGHT AND QUESTIONS FOR COUNSEL

[Specify the requested action or relief]

ENCLOSURES

None

Place: [place]
Date: [date of signing]
Signature: ____________________
